title: Barnaby's Tiny Terror
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, cute expressive characters with big eyes, exaggerated funny facial expressions, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

Clara.look: Young woman, mid-20s, curly brown hair in a messy bun, wearing a comfy blue hoodie and grey sweatpants.

Barnaby.look: Fluffy golden retriever, large, slightly disheveled fur, with a bright orange collar.

scenes.image: [[Clara]] looking directly at the camera with an amused expression, a massive [[Barnaby]] panting happily beside her, looking noble.
scenes.speaker: Clara
scenes.line: My massive dog fears *this* tiny thing.

scenes.image: [[Barnaby]] looking noble, sitting by a cozy fireplace in a living room, tail wagging slowly.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Barnaby was a grand Golden Retriever.

scenes.image: [[Barnaby]] playfully chasing a squirrel up a tree in a backyard, barking joyfully.
scenes.speaker: narrator

scenes.image: [[Barnaby]] playfully nudging a smiling mailman's leg, wagging his tail.
scenes.speaker: Clara
scenes.line: He guards our house so well.

scenes.image: [[Barnaby]] calmly looking out a window at a gentle thunderstorm, unfazed.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usually, nothing at all scared him.

scenes.image: [[Barnaby]] dozing peacefully on a fluffy dog bed in the living room, soft light streaming in.
scenes.speaker: narrator

scenes.image: Close up on [[Barnaby]]'s ear twitching, his eyes slowly opening with a puzzled look.
scenes.speaker: Barnaby

scenes.image: [[Barnaby]] lifting his head sharply, eyes wide with alarm, looking intently at the floor near the couch.
scenes.speaker: narrator

scenes.image: Close up on [[Barnaby]]'s terrified, wide eyes, showing exaggerated fear.
scenes.speaker: Barnaby

scenes.image: [[Barnaby]] slowly, fearfully, peering under the living room couch with wide, shaking eyes.
scenes.speaker: Clara

scenes.image: [[Clara]] entering the living room, seeing [[Barnaby]] frozen in a terrified pose, staring under the couch.
scenes.speaker: Barnaby

scenes.image: [[Barnaby]] whimpering loudly, completely hiding behind [[Clara]]'s legs, trembling.
scenes.speaker: Clara
scenes.line: A monster? Where is it, boy?

scenes.image: [[Clara]] looking around the room, confused. [[Barnaby]] peeks out from behind her legs, pointing a paw.
scenes.speaker: Barnaby

scenes.image: [[Clara]] bends down, trying to peek under the couch, a puzzled expression on her face. [[Barnaby]] cowers behind her.
scenes.speaker: Clara
scenes.line: Is it a giant, hairy spider?

scenes.image: [[Barnaby]] shaking his head vigorously, eyes squeezed shut in extreme panic.
scenes.speaker: Barnaby
scenes.line: Worse! Much, much worse than that!

scenes.image: [[Clara]]'s hand cautiously reaching under the couch, her brow furrowed in concentration.
scenes.speaker: Clara
scenes.line: Okay, I'm going to grab it.

scenes.image: Close up on [[Clara]]'s hand pulling out a tiny, grey, fluffy dust bunny between two fingers.
scenes.speaker: Clara

scenes.image: [[Clara]] holding up the tiny dust bunny with a smirk. [[Barnaby]]'s horrified face fills the background, eyes wide.
scenes.speaker: Clara
scenes.line: It's just a tiny dust bunny!

scenes.image: Close up on the tiny dust bunny, slightly rotating to emphasize its small size and fluffiness.
scenes.speaker: narrator

scenes.image: [[Barnaby]] has dramatically jumped onto the very back of the sofa, trembling violently, staring at the dust bunny with pure terror.
scenes.speaker: Barnaby

scenes.image: [[Clara]] sighs dramatically, rolling her eyes, holding the dust bunny up with one hand.
scenes.speaker: Clara

scenes.image: [[Barnaby]] still trembling on the sofa back, looking petrified. [[Clara]] smiles knowingly at the camera, holding the dust bunny.
scenes.speaker: Clara

caption: My Giant Dog's Secret Fear Will Shock You! 😱
yt_title: My Giant Dog's Secret Fear Will Shock You! 😱
description:
You'd think Barnaby was fearless. But wait until you see what sends him running for cover!
This fluffy terror brought the house down.
